title: P16 first chain: the B4 empty-list control fed a non-empty file (my patch glued ': > file' onto an echo line)
what_went_wrong: The patch replaced the anchor 'echo "## B4 / B2 input errors"' plus its newline with text that ended without a newline, so the next line ': > /tmp/p15nc_empty.txt' became arguments of echo. The 'empty' list contained the echo text, the comparator exited 1 (a real encounter failed) instead of 2, and p15_line_negctl.sh reported 32/33.
root_cause: A text patch that consumes a newline in its anchor must re-emit it; the patched file was syntax-checked (bash -n) but not read around the patched line.
detection: P16 chain step 3d: 'FAIL B4 empty list exit (got 1, want 2)'; /tmp/p15nc_b4a.txt showed 'ENC ## B4 / B2 input errors: verdict=EQUAL'.
impact: No false pass: the control reported FAIL and the first chain was kept as recorded (chain.log). Only this check was invalid; the product code was not at fault.

correction.applied: p15_line_negctl.sh fixed (one line), manifest b (22 files), p16_chain_b.sh re-ran the fixture-only driver and the line controls on the final bytes.

rule: After a patch, read the patched lines in the output file, not only the syntax check; a control that expects an input error must record the input it actually used.
